text:
maria: anyone else getting a bunch of p99 complaints for /v1/generate? started ~0500 PT after the runtime rollout. multiple customers reported slow streaming starts :cry:
sam: checking metrics now. do you have a sample request id or customer id?
jin: i pulled the histogram for host pool `runtime-a` — p95 jumped 180ms -> 420ms, p99 went to ~1.2s around 05:02. heat map looks like spike associated with cold-kv misses / new kernel path. attaching a quick ascii dump:
```
05:00:00 - p50 120ms p95 180ms p99 240ms
05:02:00 - p50 140ms p95 420ms p99 1200ms
05:04:00 - p50 130ms p95 400ms p99 1100ms
```
elaine: ops-bot posted the canary green at 04:58 and full rollout completed at 05:00. we didn't see alerts during canary but traffic patterns in prod are heavier.
ops-bot: @maria @sam deployment runtime-v3.14 -> rollout completed -> 100% at 2026-02-15T05:00:00Z
maria: customer example: req id `req_8f4d2a` (org: acme-pay) — they see streaming start delay ~900ms. I gave them a temporary route to dedicated but would like a platform workaround asap.
sam: can you paste the request shape? especially prompt length and top_k/top_p? some regressions are seen only on longer context.
maria: simple prompt ~60 tokens, streaming enabled, model rwd-2.1, no function calls. headers: `x-routing-segment: segmentation-a`.
jin: filtering traces for `segmentation-a` shows an increase in slow-path falls: kernel selected path `quantized-v2` for ~22% of calls now vs 5% before. KV cache cold misses spiked — maybe a cache sharding change in v3.14.
elaine: i remember a change in kernel selector that added a fallback for certain tensor shapes. could cause extra setup per-request. opening a quick PR link: https://stash.redwood/repo/runtime/changes/453
sam: reproduction on staging with exact headers and model pinned to runtime-v3.14 -> i can repro p99 ~900ms when kv cold. with runtime pinned to v3.13 p99 stays ~220ms.
jin: good repro. minimal repro steps for SRE runbook:
1) curl -H "x-routing-segment: segmentation-a" -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"<60 tokens>","stream":true}'
2) run 10 warmup requests then 100 single requests concurrently
3) flush kv cache on the target host between runs: `sudo /opt/runtime/bin/kv_flush`

sam: mitigation options:
- temporary rollout rollback to v3.13 (fastest, but needs approvals)
- apply a hotfix to kernel selector to revert fallback logic (requires patch + canary)
- route `segmentation-a` traffic to a previous pool (routing policy change)
- increase warmup / prefetch for KV cache on rollout (band-aid)

maria: customer needs immediate relief — recommend routing them to dedicated or previous pool for now. can we do routing change for a handful of orgs?
elaine: yes, we can add a traffic rule in console to route `x-org:acme-pay` to pool `runtime-legacy`. i'll prepare the rule and hold for ops signoff.
ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0412 - post-rollout p99 spike - page oncall (priority P2)
sam: i'll try a targeted rollback for one shard to measure impact. if p99 drops we can roll back fully.
jin: also worth checking kernel selection telemetry aggregation — maybe the selector probability table got miscomputed due to a dtype edge-case.
maria: assigned actions:
- sam: run targeted rollback on shard-7 and report p95/p99 within 15m
- elaine: prepare routing rule for critical orgs and coordinate change window
- jin: dig into kernel selector logs and PR 453 root cause
- maria: communicate workaround to acme-pay support thread (i informed them about routing to dedicated)

elaine: update: routing rule staged, ready to flip once rollback results in the next 10m
sam: rollback started on shard-7 at 05:22Z
jin: quick note — tracing shows an extra kernel init call per-request in v3.14 when quantized-v2 is selected. patch idea: memoize kernel init per-worker thread to avoid repeated setup.
sam: rollback on shard-7 complete. live metrics: p95 for shard-7 back to 200ms, p99 down to 260ms. looks promising.
maria: awesome. if rollback keeps stable, prep full rollback and notif CS/SE teams.
ops-bot: rollback action logged by deploy-system (user: sam)
maria: i'll keep customer updated. jin please post proposed hotfix PR when ready and we can run a small canary for that patch.
jin: will do — drafting PR with memoization change and a small perf test. ETA 3h for review + canary.
sam: summary: cause likely kernel selection + per-request kernel init in v3.14 causing cold-path stalls at scale. mitigation: targeted rollback succeeded; route rules staged for critical orgs; hotfix being prepared.
maria: thanks team :thumbsup: i'll close this thread once CS confirms acme-pay is stable. keep pings in #eng-sre if anything flips back.
